help_text:
owa-graph users - Find/list users, manager and direct reports

Shortcuts:
  list           List users (--top, --select, --filter)
  find           Search users by displayName or mail
  get            Show one user by --id (or positional)
  manager        Show user's manager
  directreports  List user's direct reports

Common flags accepted by every shortcut:
  --pretty   Human-readable output (table for known shapes, indented JSON otherwise)
  --ndjson   Stream collection items one JSON object per line
  --retry    Honor Retry-After once on 429/503
